title: Warp square button
description: Square uppercase mono buttons with wide tracking: a solid ink fill, a hairline outline, a citron fill with an ink border, a blue outline, and a white-on-brand inverse. Every one turns electric blue on hover in 150ms.
notes: colour change is 150ms ease; the optional arrow nudges 2px right; off with reduced motion
name: warp-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
ink: solid ink fill · outline: hairline border on the page · citron: highlight fill with an
ink border · blue: brand-coloured outline · inverse: white fill with brand text (on brand bands)

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 32px (header) · md: 34px (sections) · lg: 40px, normal case (product cards)

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label that nudges right on hover

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon after the label (e.g. a chevron for a menu)
